criteria.detail: The v2 implementation and acceptance tests match spec.md and spec.json; sdrive verify returns PASS (matched 28, missing 0, renamed 0, extra 0). The scanner fix covers server, backoffice, web, realtime and packages, .prisma, .env.example and workspace package.json files.

tasks.json: 14 of 14 implementation tasks completed: true (P8 4, P9 3, P10 1, P11 2, P12 4); tasks.md has no unchecked implementation rows. The T12.2 formatter claim is contradicted by the format check and is recorded under C09.
traceability.json has 16 rows covering all 19 acceptance criteria; every row has at least one testId and status complete. The 16 rows are FR-039..FR-048 and NFR-014..NFR-019; no AC is unmapped.
19 of 19 acceptance criteria in scope, 0 withdrawn; 19 test IDs linked and passing: 100% coverage.
.sdrive/reports/tests/test-report-authentication-onboarding-and-access-control-v2-2026-11-07.md exists, records 19/19 AC tests, and is newer than spec.md and plan.md (both 2026-11-06).

test-evidence.json exists, exitCode 0, summary.failed 0, summary.total 16 > 0, commit 2c690a8 equals HEAD, branch feature/auth-onboarding. The summary counts the 16 Jest tests; the same command ran the 3 Vitest tests, and the raw log reports 16 + 1 + 2 = 19. The report and raw log reconcile the 19/19; the parser limitation is recorded as finding F5.

The 92-file diff against main contains substantial product work not present in plan.json or the v2 productItems: settings/custom roles (BP-035), organization overview, workspace shell/switcher, and related DTOs, migrations and tests. Planned component paths are 16; the rest are unplanned. The branch is based on main and has no other feature's commits, but the unplanned scope is a release blocker.

No .only, xit, xdescribe, it.skip, describe.skip or test.skip in the v2 test files; no empty expect(true)/expect(1) assertions. All 19 AC IDs appear in test names. The -t filters in the evidence command skip only non-AC tests and the report states this.

TypeScript passes for server and backoffice; eslint passes for both. pnpm format:check exits 2 on repository-wide pre-existing files (.sdrive/templates, backoffice/scripts, server/src/auth/auth.e2e.spec.ts, test/*.mjs) even though the v2 changed files were formatted by the pre-commit hook. The T12.2 formatter task is therefore marked complete inaccurately.

Secrets: the diff scan is clean; matches are test fixtures and test passwords, and server/.env remains ignored while .env.example carries names only. CON-511..CON-519 are wired. Dependencies: pnpm audit reports 2 critical advisories in tinypool (dev-only, pre-existing) and 5 moderate advisories in Vitest/glob/minimatch; nodemailer 10.3.1 has no advisory in this audit. No independent v2 security report exists, so the overall security status is not_verified.

The feature's acceptance suites pass 19/19: 16 server Jest tests and 3 backoffice Vitest tests. The full repository suite was not re-run in this review; the test report's 19/19 AC evidence is the basis for this criterion.

README.md and CHANGELOG.md have no diff against main. The feature adds user-visible invitation status/resend/cancel/decline controls and settings screens, so the user-facing documentation is not up to date.

NFR-014 (SMTP), NFR-015 (.env.example names only), NFR-016 (send outside the transaction), NFR-017 (escaping, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML), NFR-018 (EN/AR/FR and RTL strings) and NFR-019 (bounded invitation/member lists) are covered by the tests and the reviewed code. The v2 spec declares no performance or SEO NFR.

The review cannot clear the feature: change scope fails (C07), code quality fails on the format check (C09), documentation fails (C12), and security is not_verified because of the dev-only critical advisories and the absent v2 security report (C10).
sdrive verify authentication-onboarding-and-access-control returns PASS: matched 28, missing 0, withdrawn 0, renamed 0, extra 0. The verification.json report is committed at the reviewed HEAD.

gh run list shows no CI run for feature/auth-onboarding or HEAD 2c690a8. .github/workflows/ci.yml triggers on pushes to main/master and on pull requests only; the branch has no PR and the reviewer may not open one. Historical main runs are green, but they do not cover this HEAD.

The first check returned exit 5 because the framework-sync race had the permission file in an intermediate state; the immediate re-run returned allowed for kenule500 (admin), and permissions.json contains /sdrive:review -> [admin, reviewer]. The audit proceeded only after the allowed result.
feature.assignee is absent and the workspace has one member (kenule500, admin), who also authored the branch. The conflict is recorded. This is a FAIL verdict, so no self-approval is being requested.

findings.issue: Unplanned product scope is on the v2 branch. Settings and custom roles (BP-035), the organization overview, the workspace shell/switcher, clinic-settings/role DTOs and migrations, and their tests are not in the v2 plan or productItems. baseline.detail: JWT access/refresh behaviour is unchanged; the invitation and membership routes are guarded by the existing JWT guard.
RolesGuard and @Roles() remain on the admin routes; the new invitation and role-change routes use the existing capability checks.
app.use(helmet()) remains applied globally in server/src/main.ts.
The global ThrottlerGuard remains registered; the new endpoints inherit the global limit.
The global ValidationPipe uses whitelist, forbidNonWhitelisted and transform; the new DTOs are validated by it.
Prisma parameterises the new queries; no new raw SQL or string concatenation was introduced.
React escapes the rendered values and the mail templates escape every interpolation; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML was added.
The refresh token remains an HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie; the new mutations are POST/PATCH, not GET.
.env remains git-ignored; server/.env.example documents the new SMTP keys by name only, with no values.

performance.reason: The v2 spec declares no performance or SEO NFR. NFR-014..NFR-019 cover SMTP delivery, environment documentation, transaction boundaries, escaping, EN/AR/FR RTL localization and bounded pagination.
performance.method: No benchmark target exists; no performance report is required for this version.
